newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DLJ reiterates May & Speh buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DLJ reiterates May & Speh buy.

text.p: -- Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette reiterated its buy rating on May & Speh Inc, a market source familiar with the research report said Thursday.

-- The move comes after May & Speh said Wednesday it expects earnings for the first quarter ended December 31 to be $0.08-$0.10 a share, below some analysts estimates. May & Speh shares plunged to 8-1/8, down 4-3/8, on volume of 1.4 million shares Thursday.
-- The Donaldson Lufkin and Jenrette analyst would not confirm the research report Thurday.
-- The analyst said he had been expecting earnings of $0.11 a share for the quarter, according to the market source.

-- But the analyst also said that May & Speh, which provides computer-based information management services, mainly to direct marketing clients, is still growing the business very rapidly and very profitably, even with the company's announcement Wednesday, the market source said.
